meta.name: abstraction-laddering
meta.description: Move between concrete and abstract framings — 3 levels up (Why?) and 3 levels down (How?) to find the most productive research level.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在具体与抽象之间切换思考层次，找到最佳研究切入点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要从不同抽象层次分析问题或梳理思路
copy.tagline_en: Move between concrete and abstract framings to find the most productive research level
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to analyze problems or structure thoughts at different levels of abstraction

howto.what: Claude会使用“为什么”（Why？）向上提问三层，以及“怎么做”（How？）向下提问三层，帮助你从具体和抽象的不同层次分析问题，找到最有价值的研究角度。
howto.when: 当你提出一个需要多角度分析的问题，或要求探索不同抽象层次时，技能自动启动。

say.text: 帮我分析“用户流失”这个问题的上下三层抽象层次。
用抽象阶梯法理解“团队效率低”这个现象。
say.note: 将从一个具体现象出发逐步抽象再到具体行动。

howto.what_en: Claude asks "Why?" three levels up (more abstract) and "How?" three levels down (more concrete) to help you analyze problems from different abstraction levels and find the most productive framing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask a question requiring multi-level analysis or request exploring different abstraction levels.

say_en.text: Analyze the problem of "user churn" with abstraction laddering, 3 levels up and down.
say_en.note: Claude will generate 3 Whys and 3 Hows steps.

say_en.text: Use abstraction laddering to understand "low team efficiency".
say_en.note: Starts from a concrete observation and moves up then down.
